value_format.description: 返回 LogicValue 的显示格式；不改变比较、采样或底层四态值。

timeout_ms.description: Positive public frontend-to-engine request timeout in milliseconds. Omit limits.timeout_ms to disable the public watchdog.

description: Preview or export filtered APB transactions from one complete time range.
x-description-zh: 预览或导出完整时间范围内过滤后的 APB 事务。
x-purpose: 预览或导出 APB 事务。
x-how_it_works: 必须给出完整 time_range；direction 与顶层 address exact/range/mask 取 AND。无 output.path 时固定最多返回 8 行 data.preview；有 path 时写一个按时间排序的 TSV/CSV data artifact 和 meta，不回退到 query/stream。
x-when_to_use: 把完整过滤结果交给外部表格或脚本，并保留扫描、匹配、字节数与完整性证据。
x-arg_contract_notes: required: name, time_range.begin/end; optional: direction, address, render_time_unit, value_format, output; output.file_format: tsv/csv; file_format requires path

use_when: Need a bounded in-response APB preview or one complete TSV/CSV transaction artifact plus metadata.
do_not_use_when: Do not use it for aggregate-only APB counts, interactive transaction selection, AXI semantics, or generic valid-ready streams.

alternatives.when: Interactively select or inspect APB transactions without creating an artifact.
Need only aggregate APB counts and unresolved-filter diagnostics.

constraints: required: name, time_range.begin/end; optional: direction, address, render_time_unit, value_format, output; output.file_format: tsv/csv; file_format requires path
